content:
**Lemonade** is a drink in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

A refreshing drink that improves AP. This version of lemonade is made without the key ingredient of lemon, which Mr. Squeeze indicates is because "I'm fresh out of lemons so I've had to make do with ingredients that are less... ideal." [1] 

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Acid (5) Boiled Water (2) Sugar (3) Wood (5) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Lemonade | | Lemonade (1) | 

Lemonade is mentioned on the grandstand at Tyler County Fairgrounds.
